info.title: AITable.ai Universal API
info.description: AITable.ai is a spreadsheet-database platform for managing spaces, datasheets, records, fields, views, files, teams, and roles through the AITable Fusion API.

post.description: Creates a new datasheet in AITable.ai.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

spaceId.description: AITable space ID where the datasheet will be created.

name.description: Name of the datasheet to create. Maximum 100 characters.

folderId.description: Optional folder node ID. If omitted, AITable creates the datasheet in the working directory.

fields[].description: Optional array of field definitions to create with the datasheet. AITable allows up to 200 fields.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
